cornelli: Johanna Spyri, creator of Heidi, wrote this children's novel about Cornelli, a lonely little girl growing up in a grand house. When she is sent to the countryside, friendship and mountain air begin to heal her sadness. Told with Spyri's gentle warmth, the story carries her familiar message: love and nature can mend a child's heart.
the-tattva-muktavali: This Sanskrit philosophical work, the Tattva-Muktavali — a necklace of truths — expounds Vedantic wisdom in verse. Its editor brings an important text of Indian thought to wider notice. A gem of classical Hindu philosophy. Short, shining verses on the nature of reality reward slow and thoughtful reading.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acciajuoli: A 1913 Catholic Encyclopedia entry on the Acciajuoli — the great Florentine bankers and statesmen. John Joseph A'Becket traces their rise and fall. catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acephali: A 1913 entry on the Acephali — the headless ones, a Monophysite sect without a chief. John Joseph A'Becket explains their name and creed. catholic-encyclopedia-1913-aloysius-gent: A 1913 entry on Aloysius Gentili — the Rosminian missionary to England and Ireland. Louis Casartelli honors his zeal. His missions stirred the faithful.
